description: This file defines the 'WorkoutDetailFragment' class, a UI component responsible for displaying workout video details and playing the associated video using ExoPlayer. It manages the view lifecycle, binds data to UI elements, and initializes media playback.

classes.name: WorkoutDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays details of a workout and plays associated media content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves the workout ID from arguments, and loads workout data.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment's UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up observers for workout detail data and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer with the provided media URL and starts playback.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases the ExoPlayer resources when no longer needed.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles fragment stop event; currently releases media player resources.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view binding when the fragment's view is destroyed.
